title: Interesting history of...
text: Interesting history of Barcelona from 100 BC through the 1920s. Fun walk through the Gothic Quarter avoiding the most of the summer heat. Guide was very friendly, knowledgeable, and warm. Highly recommend.
author: g4zgwsfhx6

title: From a pessimisst
text: I didn't think that I was going to enjoy this and I really did.  Also, I wish there was a way to tip the guide.  I had no Euros left by the time I got to the tour.  Thank you
author: ivansI3001WC

title: Fun trip around the gothic quarter!
text: This waking tour was great! Our guide took us all around the gothic quarter with interesting stories! It was mostly mythic legends instead of actual History lessons,  but soever it for what it was. Would maybe change the title of experience to fit that experience better but over all very good!
author: Emilee_R

title: Very recommended experience
text:
Very recommended!! Our tour guide was Paul, vary kind and paitiant 
The tour was fun and interesting, we got to know Barcelona from different perspective
author: 313morm

title: Barcelona Gothic
text:
If you have never wandered the dark streets of Barcelonas Gothic Quarter at night do this !! 
Our guide was late but I don’t think it was his fault maybe got called in late for some other guide!  He was a great storyteller
author: Margaret_W
